connectorUiConfig.title: FullHunt Vulnerabilities
connectorUiConfig.descriptionMarkdown: The [FullHunt](https://fullhunt.io) Vulnerabilities data connector ingests vulnerabilities FullHunt identified on your external assets. The connector takes a full snapshot once a day; each snapshot re-ingests every vulnerability, so query the latest record per IssueId from the [FullHunt Enterprise API](https://docs.fullhunt.io) into Microsoft Sentinel. | project Host, Title, Severity, StatusName, IdentifiedAt, LastSeen

FullHuntVulnerabilities_CL

| summarize Vulnerabilities = count() by Severity

properties.descriptionHtml:
Note: Please refer to the following before installing the solution:

• Review the solution Release Notes

• There may be known issues pertaining to this Solution, please refer to them before installing.

The FullHunt solution for Microsoft Sentinel brings your external attack surface into Microsoft Sentinel so you can monitor, hunt and respond to changes in it.

Data connectors ingest FullHunt attack surface alerts (new subdomains, exposed ports, DNS and certificate changes, discovered vulnerabilities), vulnerabilities, certificate-derived domains, suggested domains, and, with the FullHunt Dark Web Monitoring module, typosquatting and potential phishing domains.

Underlying Microsoft Technologies used:

This solution takes a dependency on the following technologies, and some of these dependencies either may be in Preview state or might result in additional ingestion or operational costs:

  1. Azure Monitor Logs: DCR-based Custom Logs

  2. Codeless Connector Framework (CCF)

Data Connectors: 6

Learn more about Microsoft Sentinel | Learn more about Solutions
